public_release.body: # PuPu 0.1.11 — Gemini, safer tool use, and smoother conversations More model choices, a workspace you can organize, and fixes for the moments when a conversation gets stuck. ## Download PuPu 0.1.11 ### Windows [![Download for Windows x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Windows_x64-0078D4?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/releases/download/v0.1.11/PuPu-0.1.11-windows-x64-setup.exe) ### macOS [![Download for Mac — Apple Silicon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mac-Apple_Silicon-111827?style=for-the-badge&logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/releases/download/v0.1.11/PuPu-0.1.11-macos-arm64.dmg) [![Download for Mac — Intel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mac-Intel-64748B?style=for-the-badge&logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/releases/download/v0.1.11/PuPu-0.1.11-macos-x64.dmg) Not sure which Mac you have? Open **Apple menu → About This Mac**. Choose **Apple Silicon** for an Apple M-series chip, or **Intel** for an Intel processor. ### Linux [![Download for Ubuntu / Debian x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ubuntu_%2F_Debian-x64_DEB-E95420?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/releases/download/v0.1.11/PuPu-0.1.11-linux-x64.deb) [![Download Linux AppImage x64](https://img.shields.io/badge/Linux-x64_AppImage-2563EB?style=for-the-badge&logo=linux&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/releases/download/v0.1.11/PuPu-0.1.11-linux-x64.AppImage) ## What's new ### Gemini, DeepSeek and Kimi Gemini joins PuPu's native model providers. DeepSeek and Kimi now have first-class provider sections with consistent API-key controls, without needing the experimental custom-provider setting. Shipped provider definitions come from the app, so preset updates no longer depend on saving your key again. ([#163](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/163), [#202](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/202)) ### A skill menu you can organize The `/` command palette becomes a searchable tree, with plugin folders and your own categories. Use **Organize skills** to arrange commands and folders in a dedicated organizer. ([#232](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/232)) ### A cleaner chat toolbar Reorder the movable controls in the attachment row and tuck less-used controls into the overflow menu. Keep the tools you use most within reach. ([#217](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/217)) ### Clearer questions and plugin information - Agent questions now support a dedicated free-text answer form, alongside clearer question guidance. ([#224](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/224)) - Plugin pages distinguish publisher origin from verification status. Catalog inclusion does not imply that a third-party integration has been security-verified. ([#278](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/278)) - The Store adds research MCP integrations and curated skill packs, with fixes that let instruction-only skill commands run without being mistaken for runtime toolkits. ([#283](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/283)) ## Fixes and reliability - Fixed a shell-confirmation bypass involving JSON-string tool arguments. ([#264](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/264)) - Fixed tool-confirmation persistence failures and stopping conversations blocked on a pending interaction. ([#261](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/261), [#262](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/262)) - Fixed internal handoff context displacing the user's request, and Memory V2 context being mistaken for an untrusted user request. ([#257](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/257), [#268](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/268)) - Fixed the first-message restore race in newly created chats. ([#266](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/266)) - Corrected supported reasoning-effort choices for GPT-5.3 Codex. ([#263](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/263)) - Improved Ollama context-window handling and usage display. ([#227](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/227), [#265](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/265), [#280](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/280)) - Preserved web-fetch error response bodies and fixed attachment-panel clicks being swallowed after a menu closes. ([#267](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/267), [#273](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/273)) Memory V2 remains enabled in Active mode, not shadow mode. ## Installation and upgrades - **macOS:** Apple Silicon and Intel packages are signed and notarized. - **Windows:** the x64 installer is code-signed. - **Linux:** x64 AppImage and Debian packages are available. Fresh-install qualification passed on all four platform targets. Upgrade-and-restart qualification from **0.1.10 to 0.1.11** passed on Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon/Intel using the sealed release candidate. Linux users should install the new package manually. Upgrades from versions older than 0.1.10 are not covered by this qualification; use the appropriate installer and back up important chats and settings first. These results cover the tested installation and upgrade paths, not every provider, plugin or conversation scenario. ## Known limitations - **Kimi K2.7 Code:** thinking/tool-call replay can still fail with `durable_provider_turn_uncertain`. This is tracked for 0.1.12 in [#292](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues/292). Kimi K3/K2.6 tool compatibility currently uses a non-thinking-mode workaround; it is not full thinking/replay support. - Some skill-organizer text falls back to English outside English and Simplified Chinese. - External model and MCP services may require separate accounts, API keys or payments. Plugin labels describe origin and the recorded verification scope, not a guarantee of service quality, security or paid-service delivery. If something goes wrong, please [open an issue](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/issues) with your operating system, provider/model and reproduction steps. Remove credentials and private conversation content before sharing logs. ## 🚧 Agent Builder Countdown — Targeting November 2026 Agent Builder is planned for v0.2.0, with v0.1.13 as the only planned feature release between v0.1.12 and v0.2.0. v0.1.12 — Polish the foundations: improve the current chat, model, tool, and Skill experience, and address known issues. v0.1.13 — Bring the Builder together: add live execution status, smoother canvas editing, starter templates, multilingual support, and the ability to steer a running workflow. v0.2.0 — Launch the basic Agent Builder: build and run your own Agent workflows with a stable runtime and clear visibility into their progress. Our target is November 2026. This is an estimate, not a fixed release date. Each release will include a progress update and any changes to the timeline. **[Full changelog: v0.1.10 → v0.1.11](https://github.com/haoxiang-xu/PuPu/compare/v0.1.10...v0.1.11)**
